records.title: AlphaZeroBeta: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Market-Neutral Portfolios
records.author: Boris Belyakov

claims.objective: Market-neutral portfolio construction with benchmark-relative alpha and near-zero systematic market exposure.
claims.architecture: CNN-GRU policy/value network trained with Recurrent PPO
claims.walk_forward: 36-month training + 6-month validation + non-overlapping 6-month test; advance 6 months and reset model weights each fold
claims.data_boundary: Paper reports Bloomberg Terminal and Financial Modeling Prep inputs; complete licensed-data-dependent code/data are not redistributable.
